description: This file contains extension methods for managing reminders in Orleans grains, including registering, updating, unregistering, and retrieving reminders. It is a utility/helper class to facilitate interactions with the Orleans reminder service, specifically targeting grains implementing IRemindable.

classes.name: GrainReminderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders for Orleans grains.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a persistent reminder for a grain implementing IRemindable, using grain context and reminder details.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a specified reminder for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Fetches a specific reminder by name for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all registered reminders for a grain.
